title: Editorial rulings ledger
prose: The adjudication ledger: every open editorial question and every ruling, each recorded as a note with a lifecycle (open -> asked in round N -> ruled -> encoded in rule/guide-section X, superseding Y). The highest-leverage channel in the project: one well-chosen question settles more rows than a hundred ratings. Expect the reviewer to supersede herself across rounds — that is normal; the ledger is how the process metabolises it. Korean examples: hip (region vs joint), plain X-ray forms (reversed between rounds), -gram image endings.
